column1: # Cross-request leak check. Columns: id <TAB> lang <TAB> url
# The sandbox has one site and one language, so the TAE check (same slug on three sites)
# does not apply. What can leak on a shared worker instead is one page's state into the
# next request: perf-leak.sh fires these back to back, cold then warm, and checks that every
# response is the page that was asked for (canonical + title), carries no other page's
# title, has a fresh CSP nonce that matches its header, and is byte-identical across
